inspection: Static source review reconciled with available completed server components; implementation gaps remain.

flags.active_replay_objective: Pooled stimulus-response correlation; no full time-series/amplitude fit

findings.finding: Five independent animal-fold model fits, fold-aware trainer and all-animal calibration are plans. E121 draft identities are not fitted CV.
Peptide module/assets exist but current four-field common-state runner does not propagate peptide state or apply extrasynaptic input.
E119 tested one saved direction; a reusable low-dimensional checked-descent/grouped fitter is not implemented. E118 raw direction was measured uphill.
Current correlation loss cannot identify calibrated amplitudes or complete kinetics; mean calcium summaries are fitted, not complete neural time courses.
Raw audit confirms distinct metadata IDs with no missing IDs/repeated subjects in this dataset. Filename fallback remains a structural risk for future data.
findings.initial_finding: Missing animal IDs fall back to filenames; actual metadata must be inventoried before animal-grouped CV.

findings.finding: All audited file genotype labels are WT with no subject conflicts. Source code still lacks explicit genotype selection for future data.
findings.initial_finding: Current build_statistics does not filter by genotype; NWB file count is called animals. Genotype mixture and unique worm counts need actual data audit.

findings.finding: Sensory/body/physical environment modules exist, but E120 is an atlas-only neural evaluation; no E120 body, swimming or sensory start/stop qualification.
E120 stored numerical/parameter/control/rhythm/state/panel qualification independently recomputed, source records unchanged. No new forward/full-loss replication.
findings.initial_finding: E120 reports full three-level atlas checks and independent state/panel repeat; full atlas loss was not independently repeated. Historical E104/E105 failures preserved.

findings.finding: Base template inheritance confirmed; 2 distinct base rows and 297 effective rows. Per-cell variation does not imply independently measured physiology.
findings.initial_finding: Historical polarized baseline used296 transferred AWC channel templates plus6 RMD profiles. Per-cell fitting can change scales; this is not302 independently measured neuron models. Server snapshot checks E120 base/effective conductances and template match.

findings.finding: 9538 fitted scales/strengths; stereotypical fields, LEAK/RMD and anatomy fixed. Some are engineering priors, not independently measured values.
E120 has atlas exposure. A common verified pre-atlas-fit ancestor is required for independent fold fits; no new CV ancestor lineage audit/fold runs evidenced.

conclusion: Concrete implementation/execution gaps remain; more success flags on existing network-only runs do not close them.
evidence_source: Reconciled from user-reported E121 server stdout plus local source review; no local raw inspection
